title: Consume the FT-015 transient storage prompt

gates.name: storage_prompt_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/storage-prompt.spec.ts

verify: Independent two-Account browser verification covers exact status use, eligible-only display, acknowledge/dismiss equivalence, fresh-load reappearance, Account/auth reset, no browser/backend persistence or mutation, and unchanged local_only/no-server wording.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-007 RED: no Svelte storage-status/prompt consumer exists; GREEN: exact prompt_eligible drives display and both actions close only the current component, reset on fresh load/auth change, persist nothing, and leave local_only/no-server semantics unchanged; decisive comparison: two-Account browser sequence, request/storage scan, and repeated status response; artifact: prompt evidence under .tasks/TASK-092-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Implement only the FT-016-owned mechanical presentation and transient interaction state over the FT-015 provider contract.
success_outcome: The PWA shows the exact eligible FT-015 storage warning and keeps acknowledge/dismiss component-local, Account-isolated, resettable, non-persistent, and incapable of changing storage or sync authority.
anti_goals: Do not calculate storage totals/thresholds, scan files, add prompt mutation endpoints/events, or persist state in cookies/localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB.
Do not imply upload, remote server, cooldown, storage episode, growth delta, or sync-status change.

forbidden_scope: browser or backend durable prompt state
stop_conditions: The component needs to recalculate eligibility or persist an action.
The accepted status/interaction behavior cannot be rendered without redefining FT-015.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA only for Svelte rendering and transient component state; FT-015/Photo Intake retains every provider rule.
Use exact response values; no threshold or sync logic is duplicated in the client.
invariants: Both actions close only the current rendered instance and persist nothing.
Fresh load or Account/auth change discards prompt state and local_only never changes.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-007: eligible-only exact status display, both transient actions, fresh-load/account reset, zero persistence/mutation, and no server/upload implication.
T3 harm proof uses isolated browser contexts/accounts and confirms storage status, backend rows, Timeline, and browser storage remain unchanged.
